criteria.requirement: Implement inflect.counted.counted(engine,noun,count,*,words=False,zero="0",separator=" "). Require nonempty noun and nonnegative integer count (bool rejected), real plural_noun with explicit count and cloned current custom rules/classical options. Support custom zero label, number_to_words and separator. Persistent count, number spelling scratch state and user rules of original engine remain unchanged on success or failure. Zero grammatical form follows actual current classical mode; do not hardcode English singular/plural suffixes.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
